title: Product type, shipping and warranty FAQ
notes: Official global FAQ states mostly assembled complete-bike delivery, typical three-week standard-bike and six-to-seven-week custom-bike delivery, and warranty periods including five years for Quick/Quick Pro framesets, three years for wheelsets, two years for carbon components, and one year for Shimano/SRAM on complete bikes. Coverage requires the original purchaser and proof. Mainland-China delivery and service handling are not explicitly confirmed.
